test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 15 March, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: Who was appointed as the new chairman of Central Board of Direct Taxes (CBDT) in June 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __Nitin Gupta.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__ **

__
 
• IRS officer Nitin Gupta has been appointed as the new Central Board of Direct Taxes (CBDT) chairman.
 
• Mr. Gupta is an Indian Revenue Service (IRS) officer of the 1986 batch of the Income Tax cadre and is currently serving as the Member (investigation) in CBDT.
 
• The post of the CBDT chief was being held in an additional capacity by Board member and 1986-batch IRS officer Sangeeta Singh.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ​Important Appointments:

 
 
• Retired IAS officer and former Drinking Water and Sanitation Secretary Parameswaran Iyer has been appointed as the new Chief Executive Officer of NITI Aayog. 
 
• The New Development Bank (NDB) of the BRICS countries has appointed Dr. D J Pandian as the Director-General of its India Regional Office in Gujarat International Finance Tec-City (GIFT City).
 
• Senior Diplomat Ruchira Kamboj has been appointed as the next Ambassador and Permanent Representative of India to the United Nations.
 
• Somali president Hassan Sheikh Mohamud on 15 June 2022 appointed Hamza Abdi Barre as the country's Prime Minister.
 
• Justice Bhimanagouda Sanganagouda Patil has been appointed as the new Lokayukta of Karnataka.
 
• President Ram Nath Kovind has given Justice Pradip Kumar Mohanty the additional charge of the Lokpal chairperson.​
 
• Dinkar Gupta, a 1987-batch IPS officer and former chief of the Punjab Police, has been appointed Director-General of the National Investigation Agency (NIA).
